zh: 遗留核心银行系统难以集成 AI 能力
监管合规成本逐年攀升
实时风控对延迟要求极为苛刻
开放银行与 API 经济带来架构压力
en: Legacy core banking systems resist AI integration
Regulatory compliance costs rising year over year
Real-time risk controls demand ultra-low latency
Open banking and API economy create architectural strain

approach.zh: 以 AI 就绪度和架构现代化为双轨，先评估核心系统约束，再分阶段解耦关键业务流程，同步搭建合规自动化流水线。
approach.en: Dual-track approach: assess core system constraints for AI readiness, progressively decouple critical business flows, and build compliance automation pipelines in parallel.

zh: AI 推理延迟降低 40–70%
合规报告生成时间从周缩短至小时
核心系统可用性达到 99.995%
en: Compliance report generation from weeks to hours

zh: 线上线下渠道数据割裂
个性化推荐引擎实时性不足
供应链预测准确率低
促销高峰系统弹性不够
en: Insufficient system elasticity during peak promotions

approach.zh: 以数据平台统一为起点，构建实时特征工程与推荐管道，同时将核心交易系统迁移至弹性云原生架构。
approach.en: Start with unified data platform, build real-time feature engineering and recommendation pipelines, while migrating core transaction systems to elastic cloud-native architecture.

zh: 推荐点击率提升 15–25%
供应链预测误差降低 30%
峰值吞吐能力提升 6–10 倍
患者数据跨系统互通困难
AI 辅助诊断的监管审批路径不明确
遗留临床系统改造风险高
数据隐私合规要求严格
en: Unclear regulatory pathway for AI-assisted diagnosis

approach.zh: 以 FHIR 标准推动互操作性，在合规沙箱中验证 AI 模型，采用绞杀者模式渐进式替换遗留临床系统。
approach.en: Drive interoperability with FHIR standards, validate AI models in compliance sandboxes, use strangler-fig pattern for progressive legacy clinical system replacement.

zh: 跨系统数据共享时间从数天缩短至秒级
AI 诊断第二意见准确率达专家水平
零停机临床系统迁移
en: Cross-system data sharing from days to seconds
AI diagnostic second-opinion accuracy at expert level

zh: OT/IT 融合困难
产线数据采集与实时分析链路长
预测性维护模型落地率低
从职能型到产品型组织的转型阻力大
en: Long data-collection-to-analysis pipeline on production lines

approach.zh: 以边缘计算打通 OT/IT，构建数字孪生与预测性维护平台，同时重塑技术组织为产品型结构。
approach.en: Bridge OT/IT with edge computing, build digital twins and predictive maintenance platforms, while reshaping technology org into product-oriented structure.

zh: 非计划停机减少 25–40%
新产品导入周期缩短 30%
工程师人均产出提升 50%
碳中和目标缺乏可量化的技术路径
分布式能源管理复杂度高
遗留 SCADA 系统安全风险
能源交易平台延迟要求苛刻
en: Net-zero targets lack quantifiable technical pathways
High complexity in distributed energy management
Stringent latency requirements for energy trading platforms

approach.zh: 以碳排放数据平台为基石，构建能源优化数字孪生，同时升级 SCADA 安全架构并现代化交易系统。
approach.en: Build carbon-emission data platform as foundation, construct energy-optimization digital twins, while upgrading SCADA security and modernizing trading systems.

zh: 碳排放预测准确率达 95%
可再生能源并网效率提升 20%
交易系统延迟降至亚毫秒级
en: Trading system latency reduced to sub-millisecond

zh: 用户增长放缓，ARPU 提升困难
5G/边缘基础设施投资回报不明确
内容推荐与广告系统架构老化
数据隐私法规日益严格
en: Slowing user growth with ARPU pressure
Aging content recommendation and ad-system architecture

approach.zh: 以 AI 驱动的内容个性化与广告优化为增长引擎，同时以平台工程降低基础设施单位成本。
approach.en: Use AI-driven content personalization and ad optimization as growth engines, while reducing infrastructure unit costs through platform engineering.

zh: 用户留存率提升 10–20%
广告 CPM 提升 25%
基础设施单用户成本降低 30%
政府采购流程慢，敏捷交付受限
跨部门数据共享的法律与技术障碍
公民数字服务体验远落后于商业标准
网络安全威胁面扩大
en: Slow procurement processes limit agile delivery
Legal and technical barriers to cross-agency data sharing
Citizen digital service experience lags far behind commercial standards

approach.zh: 采用政府科技敏捷框架，以小规模快速交付建立信任，逐步扩大数字服务平台覆盖范围。
approach.en: Adopt gov-tech agile frameworks, build trust through small-scale rapid delivery, progressively expand digital service platform coverage.

zh: 服务上线时间从年缩短至季度
公民满意度提升 30 个百分点
安全事件检测时间缩短 80%
en: Service launch timeline from years to quarters
Citizen satisfaction lift of 30 percentage points

zh: 软件定义汽车带来全新架构挑战
OTA 更新与功能安全合规矛盾
车联网数据量爆炸但变现困难
传统制造思维与软件文化冲突
en: Software-defined vehicle creates new architecture challenges
OTA updates conflict with functional safety compliance
Exploding vehicle telemetry data but difficult to monetize
Traditional manufacturing mindset clashes with software culture

approach.zh: 以软件定义汽车参考架构为起点，建立安全合规的 OTA 流水线，同时帮助组织培养软件文化。
approach.en: Start with SDV reference architecture, establish safety-compliant OTA pipelines, while helping the organization cultivate software culture.

zh: 新功能上市时间缩短 50%
OTA 合规审批从月缩短至天
车联网数据 ARPU 提升 2–3 倍
en: OTA compliance approval from months to days
